Scheduled maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance is excluded from qualifying downtime up to a combined 120 minutes per month; any excess is included. SLA-3. Credits are 0% when monthly availability is at least 99.9%; 10% when it is at least 99.0% but below 99.9%; 25% when it is at least 95.0% but below 99.0%; and 50% when it is below 95.0%.
